fusions.name: Quarry Tramp
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances. Its damage rises 5% for every tile you have travelled since your last strike (max 40%).

fusions.name: Heel Drop
fusions.desc: Drops down on the target, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 12 seconds, with 8% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Trail-Hardened
fusions.desc: Each stretch of ground you cover restores 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
